value: min_diameter_km drops anything below this size; default 0.001 km, with 1.0 suggested for a >=1-km population.
require_spectral_type=True rejects asteroids with no Bus / Tholen classification.
Diameter derivation precedes validation; enrichment follows it; no second eligibility filter runs before metadata/export. All-rejected builds return an empty DataFrame without a new catalog export.
A present diameter below config.min_diameter_km is rejected in validate_and_filter.
An H-derived diameter contradicted by measured mass can be replaced by diameter_from_mass_km at class density, labelled derived_mass, after eligibility filtering.
The strict gate calls _blank, which recognizes null/empty/whitespace but does not use the recognized string placeholder list.
Strict mode accepts a row if either Bus or Tholen is nonblank under _blank; this runs before spectral normalization/inference.
The Bus column replaces recognized placeholders with missing before type classification.
Tholen uses _normalise_type directly; this strips/case-folds nonempty strings but does not mask placeholder words, and the resulting value is labelled tholen.
The unmasked Tholen result fills a missing Bus class and therefore blocks later measured-albedo and assumed-albedo inference.

notes: This diagnoses the size stage order; it is not a production patch, changes no mass/diameter formulas and makes no claim about min_derived_diameter_km semantics.

value: Mask only documented missing-class string markers for the strict validation predicate; restore original spectral source cells on retained rows before the unmodified enrichment/export.
notes: No change to recognized real classes or strict=False behavior.
